title: Two Broad Separated 2D Gaussians
intuition: Baseline 2D multimodal vector task with two broad isotropic Gaussians at (-1, 0) and (+1, 0) (sigma=0.25), checking basic multimodal coverage, balanced mass, and accurate within-mode spread.
failure_mode: Recipes that collapse mode variance to points fail component_min_eigen_ratio and component_covariance_error.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 required transfer-vector task (1,200 updates, clean live evaluation).
